ruleDefinitions.name: Abused Debug Privilege by Arbitrary Parent Processes
ruleDefinitions.description: Detection of unusual child processes by different system processes

sequences.query: (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\winlogon\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\csrss\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\smss\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wininit\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\spoolsv\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\searchindexer\\\.exe$")) AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*"))) AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ route\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ADD\\ .*")))
